question: Что такое Path parameters и как это работает?
short_answer: A path parameter identifies part of the routed resource path and is converted/validated from text using the endpoint annotation.
junior_answer: A path parameter identifies part of the routed resource path and is converted/validated from text using the endpoint annotation. `/users/{user_id}` binds the segment; constraints can reject invalid values before handler execution. Static routes must not be accidentally shadowed by a broad dynamic route. Важное ограничение: Path parameters are required by the matched path; optional filters belong in query parameters.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с Path parameters?
follow_up_answer: Registering `/users/{user_id}` before a conflicting `/users/me` design can route `me` into integer validation instead of the intended handler.
